ci_coverage_decision.exact_job:
r3-preparation-unit:
    name: R3 preparation synthetic and owned-child tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Run all 130 R3 preparation unit tests
        env:
          PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: "1"
        run: |
          python - <<'PYTEST'
          import sys
          import unittest
          suite = unittest.defaultTestLoader.discover("scripts/r3_preparation", pattern="test_*.py")
          if suite.countTestCases() != 130:
              raise SystemExit("expected exact reviewed 130-test inventory")
          result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(suite)
          if result.testsRun != 130 or result.skipped or not result.wasSuccessful():
              raise SystemExit(1)
          PYTEST
